decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing a wide variety of colors to maximize damage output and control the board. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Scion of Draco, Territorial Kavu, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also using spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional control options, while Stubborn Denial offers protection. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors.

This deck is focused on assembling a powerful combo using Allosaurus Rider with Neoform or Eldritch Evolution to quickly bring out Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant or other big creatures like Griselbrand. The deck also includes cards like Planar Genesis and Consign to Memory to support the combo strategy. Furthermore, the inclusion of cards like Veil of Summer and Pact of Negation helps protect the combo from disruption, while cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Generous Ent help ramp up mana quickly to execute the combo.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to play powerful spells like Scapeshift and Primeval Titan. By utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and exploit the powerful effects of lands like Urza's Saga and Gruul Turf, players can quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm opponents with massive creatures or land combos. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Tolaria West to provide additional options and flexibility in different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to quickly and explosively win the game through efficient ramp and combo plays.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide additional reach and removal options, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls help maintain board presence. By combining speed and versatility, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, backed up by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to provide additional value and finish the game quickly. With the ability to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Ancient Adamantoise onto the battlefield early on. It also utilizes cards like Persist and Transmogrify to bring back or transform creatures for added value. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also having card draw and recursion with cards like Wrenn and Six and Faithless Looting. The mana base is set up to support the combo pieces and enable consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramping up mana to play powerful spells and abilities that control the board. It includes a mix of mana ramp, removal, and big threats like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck aims to control the game by casting Eldrazi spells and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command. It utilizes Ugin's Labyrinth to slow down the opponent's creature-based strategies while ramping up to play game-ending threats like Emrakul.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggression and blinking effects to pressure the opponent and disrupt their strategy. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and disruption like Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck have powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities that can be repeatedly activated with blink effects like Ephemerate. By blinking creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones, the deck can generate value and outpace the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to control the board while continuously applying pressure to win the game.

This deck focuses on filling up the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. The deck includes cards that manipulate the top of the library to ensure a smooth cascade into Living End. It also includes creatures with powerful abilities that can disrupt the opponent's strategy or provide additional value when they enter the battlefield. The combination of graveyard manipulation and powerful creature effects makes this deck a potent threat in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creature damage and direct damage spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. It utilizes powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Seasoned Pyromancer, along with Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional aggression. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach and a potential win condition. The mana base is optimized for efficient color access to cast its spells.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with cards that allow them to "blink" or temporarily leave the battlefield and return, triggering powerful abilities each time. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly abuse enter-the-battlefield effects and disrupt opponents' strategies. The aim is to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive plays, creating a fast-paced and versatile gameplay experience that can catch opponents off guard. With a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent.

Utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for repeated enters-the-battlefield triggers, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By constantly blinking creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can generate incremental advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide additional disruption, while Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk offer powerful finishers to close out the game.

The main concept of this Modern Ruby Storm deck is to rapidly generate mana and cast multiple spells in a single turn to unleash a powerful combo finish. By using cards like Manamorphose, Pyretic Ritual, and Desperate Ritual alongside Ruby Medallion to reduce costs, the deck aims to generate enough spells to enable a lethal Grapeshot or Past in Flames for a massive amount of damage. Ral, Monsoon Mage can also be used to further enhance the storm count and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells.

The deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost cards to deal damage to the opponent, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to control the board. Expressive Iteration helps draw into more threats, while cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide consistent pressure. Mishra's Bauble and Slickshot Show-Off allow for additional card advantage and tempo, while Cori-Steel Cutter provides a strong finisher. The mana base ensures consistent access to the necessary colors for the spells, while also enabling fetch lands for thinning the deck and triggering prowess abilities.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana through spells like Explore and Unexpected Results to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger for free with Omniscience on the board. Planar Genesis helps to ramp up even more mana while Kona, Rescue Beastie provides additional ways to cheat out big creatures. The deck also includes lands that can be sacrificed for an additional effect, such as Hedge Maze and Otawara, Soaring City, to further fuel the combo strategy.
